prompt:
Refine only the excessive valley haze and overly formal star-to-land fade in image 1. Image 2 is the finished point-star asset: retain its actual tiny point texture, density variations and irregular dust in the sky, without repainting stars into strokes, curls or glowing clouds.

The current pale blue valley mist is MUCH TOO prominent. Reduce the apparent haze brightness and opacity by roughly two-thirds. Restore the distant mountains' dark natural colours and painted terrain texture so they feel part of the SAME landscape as the nearer hills, not a separate smooth blue luminous world. Keep only a trace of mist in front of/between distant ridges and the smallest hint of low cloud in the central valley. The darkness and restrained neutral-cool colours must relate coherently across all the terrain. No glow behind mountains, no brightly lit distant faces, no luminous fog.

The haze is roughly LEVEL in its average altitude and lies in front of distant mountains; the nearer right slope occludes it. But it must NOT be a horizontal gradient, stripe, regular wave, ordered series of layers or smooth formal curtain. Make it barely perceptible and locally uneven: extremely subtle patches of differing transparency, with clear gaps and soft indistinct edges, without visually obvious repeating forms. Let a few tiny dim low stars remain visible through random clearer pockets, sometimes a little lower than their neighbours; others fade a little higher. Avoid a common horizontal cutoff or uniform graduated density. The transition should feel incidental and atmospheric, not designed. No new billowy clouds or mountain-shaped cloud banks. No light pollution or horizon light.

Keep the upper sky dark, with the SAME stars gradually more crowded inside the Milky Way, and irregular broken dust patches rather than a neat dividing line. Use image 2's finished point material wherever the sky needs reconstruction, never image 1's painted texture as a star style. Preserve the foreground, all five people and positions, central fire and its localized warmth, cave/tiny flame, river, actual mountain/tree silhouettes, rocky terrain, plants and bone. Same complete 854x1840 portrait, no text, UI, moon or additional objects.
